criteria.name: Competitor Evidence
criteria.grading_prompt: Are competitors described with specific details (features, pricing, user counts, funding), or just listed by name? If competitor-research.md does not exist, fall back to market-research.md.

anchors.PASS: 3+ competitors with at least 2 concrete data points each (pricing, user count, funding, key features)
anchors.PARTIAL: Competitors listed with some details but data is sparse or inconsistent across entries
anchors.FAIL: Competitors listed by name only, or fewer than 2 competitors identified

criteria.name: Sentiment and Demand Signals
criteria.grading_prompt: Does the research include evidence of user demand or dissatisfaction with existing solutions? If competitor-research.md does not exist, fall back to market-research.md.

anchors.PASS: Cites specific signals (forum posts, app reviews, survey data, search trends, waitlist numbers)
anchors.PARTIAL: Mentions demand exists but without specific evidence
anchors.FAIL: No demand/sentiment analysis, or only generic statements ('there is growing demand')
